task.description:
Implement DSL-03 (Error Recovery — SHOULD) per the design in src/design/dsl-03-error-recovery.md. The parser at src/expr/parser.zig already has error recovery infrastructure (recordError, synchronize, expect, sentinel). Add any missing sync points so that: 'A test input with three distinct syntax errors yields a report with three entries.'

Key areas to check:
1. Each grammar production function (parseOrExpr, parseAndExpr, parseNotExpr, parseCmpExpr, parseAddExpr, parseMulExpr, parseUnary, parsePrimary, parseIdentOrCall) — does it continue after recording an error?
2. consumeArgList — does it sync after missing ')'?
3. parseIdentOrCall — does it consume remaining args when an unknown function is detected?
4. The lexer already collects all errors; confirm they are all merged in parse().
5. Ensure the trailing ')' after function args is synchronised.

Do NOT change the ParseResult type or the public API.
Do NOT change the AST node types.
Only add/improve error recovery — do not refactor.

Write a test file tests/unit/expr_error_recovery_test.zig with the acceptance test from DSL-03: an input with three distinct syntax errors returns a report with three entries. Also add one positive test (valid expression returns .ok).
acceptance_criteria: Test input with three distinct syntax errors yields .fail with 3 ParseError entries
No changes to public API (ParseResult type, mod.zig signatures)

result.summary: Implemented DSL-03 error recovery: Gap A (dot-path sync), Gap B (single-token skip + re-parse in parsePrimary else), Gap C (consumeArgList sync after missing ')'). All three gaps verified; test file with acceptance test (3 errors in single pass) and positive test written.
